title: Multichannel highly sensitive diamond quantum magnetometer
summary: First 2-channel simultaneous NV-diamond magnetometer using frequency-division multiplexing. Two NV ensembles separated 3.6 mm; achieves 21-22 pT/sqrt(Hz) (photon shot-noise limit 6.1-7.5 pT/sqrt(Hz)), gradiometric sensitivity 14 pT/sqrt(Hz). Bandwidth 25-300 Hz. Designed for rat brain imaging. No cost data provided.
bci_relevance: Current sensitivity 21 pT/sqrt(Hz) is ~20x short of MEG-grade (1 fT/sqrt(Hz)), ~1000x short of OPM-MEG. Adequate for MCG (~50 pT) and peripheral nerve (~100 pT) but NOT brain MEG at room temperature without massive improvement. Shot-noise limit 6-7 pT/sqrt(Hz) still falls short. Independent researcher cannot bridge this gap without custom diamond growth.
independent_researcher_budget: Diamond NV ensembles from Element Six ~$500-2000 for small samples; laser + optics + lock-in ~$10k-15k. Total ~$15k-20k for single-channel at pT level. fT MEG sensitivity not achievable at this budget.
